usedFor: Todoist holds tasks and TimeCamp tracks time, so “New Task Created in Project” can mirror each with “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Task” in TimeCamp
bestTemplate.why: Each new Todoist task is mirrored in TimeCamp, so hours can be logged against it from day one.

watchOut: “New Incomplete Task” only covers tasks added in the last 15 minutes, so older ones fall outside it.
